# ThemeForest
> Premium marketplace for WordPress themes, website templates, and design assets for websites, ecommerce, and CMS platforms.

ThemeForest is part of Envato Market and helps buyers discover commercial themes, templates, and template kits from independent authors. The site emphasizes WordPress, ecommerce storefronts, HTML templates, CMS themes, and author marketplaces, with supporting pages for collections, rankings, and account activity.

## Marketplace
- [Homepage](https://themeforest.net/): Main marketplace for premium WordPress themes, website templates, and design assets.
- [Featured Files](https://themeforest.net/featured): Editorially featured themes and templates highlighted across the marketplace.
- [Popular Files](https://themeforest.net/popular_item/by_category?category=wordpress): Popular marketplace items ranked by category and buyer activity.
- [Collections](https://themeforest.net/collections): Curated public collections grouping related themes, templates, and design resources.
- [Top Authors](https://themeforest.net/authors/top): Leaderboard of top-performing authors across the ThemeForest marketplace.
- [Top New Sellers](https://themeforest.net/page/top_new_sellers): Recently successful new authors and sellers on Envato Market.
- [Free Files](https://themeforest.net/free): Rotating free files and promotional downloads from the marketplace.

## WordPress
- [WordPress Themes](https://themeforest.net/category/wordpress): Browse WordPress themes for blogs, business sites, portfolios, and stores.
- [Blog / Magazine WordPress Themes](https://themeforest.net/category/wordpress/blog-magazine): WordPress themes designed for editorial, news, and magazine websites.
- [Corporate WordPress Themes](https://themeforest.net/category/wordpress/corporate): Business and corporate WordPress themes for agencies, startups, and companies.
- [Creative WordPress Themes](https://themeforest.net/category/wordpress/creative): Portfolio and creative WordPress themes for designers, studios, and freelancers.
- [eCommerce WordPress Themes](https://themeforest.net/category/wordpress/ecommerce): WooCommerce-ready WordPress themes for online stores and product catalogs.
- [Entertainment WordPress Themes](https://themeforest.net/category/wordpress/entertainment): Themes for events, music, nightlife, and entertainment-focused websites.
- [Nonprofit WordPress Themes](https://themeforest.net/category/wordpress/nonprofit): WordPress themes for charities, fundraising, churches, and nonprofit organizations.
- [Retail WordPress Themes](https://themeforest.net/category/wordpress/retail): Themes tailored to retail brands, shops, and product-driven businesses.

## Site Templates
- [Site Templates](https://themeforest.net/category/site-templates): HTML and website templates for landing pages, business sites, and apps.
- [Admin Templates](https://themeforest.net/category/site-templates/admin-templates): Dashboard and admin panel templates for web applications and SaaS products.
- [Corporate Site Templates](https://themeforest.net/category/site-templates/corporate): Corporate HTML templates for agencies, firms, and professional services.
- [Landing Pages](https://themeforest.net/category/site-templates/landing-pages): Conversion-focused landing page templates for products, apps, and campaigns.
- [Marketing Templates](https://themeforest.net/category/site-templates/marketing): Templates for marketing sites, lead generation, and promotional campaigns.
- [Mobile Site Templates](https://themeforest.net/category/site-templates/mobile): Mobile-oriented templates optimized for handheld browsing experiences.
- [Personal Site Templates](https://themeforest.net/category/site-templates/personal): Personal website templates for resumes, portfolios, and individual brands.
- [Technology Site Templates](https://themeforest.net/category/site-templates/technology): Templates for software, startups, hosting, and technology businesses.

## eCommerce
- [eCommerce Templates](https://themeforest.net/category/ecommerce): Storefront templates and themes for ecommerce platforms and online shops.
- [WooCommerce](https://themeforest.net/category/ecommerce/woocommerce): WooCommerce themes and storefront templates for WordPress-based online stores.
- [Shopify](https://themeforest.net/category/ecommerce/shopify): Shopify themes for retail, fashion, electronics, and niche ecommerce brands.
- [Magento](https://themeforest.net/category/ecommerce/magento): Magento themes for enterprise ecommerce stores and catalog-heavy businesses.
- [OpenCart](https://themeforest.net/category/ecommerce/opencart): OpenCart templates for lightweight ecommerce storefront implementations.
- [PrestaShop](https://themeforest.net/category/ecommerce/prestashop): PrestaShop themes for merchants building customizable online stores.
- [BigCommerce](https://themeforest.net/category/ecommerce/bigcommerce): BigCommerce themes for scalable hosted ecommerce storefronts.
- [Drupal Commerce](https://themeforest.net/category/ecommerce/drupal-commerce): Drupal Commerce templates for content-driven ecommerce websites.

## CMS & Platforms
- [CMS Themes](https://themeforest.net/category/cms-themes): Themes and templates for content management systems beyond WordPress.
- [Joomla](https://themeforest.net/category/cms-themes/joomla): Joomla templates for business, magazine, portfolio, and ecommerce sites.
- [Drupal](https://themeforest.net/category/cms-themes/drupal): Drupal themes for organizations, publishers, and complex content websites.
- [Muse Templates](https://themeforest.net/category/cms-themes/muse): Adobe Muse templates for visual website building workflows.
- [Concrete5](https://themeforest.net/category/cms-themes/concrete5): Concrete5 themes for business and content-managed websites.
- [MODX Themes](https://themeforest.net/category/cms-themes/modx): MODX templates for flexible CMS-driven website projects.
- [ExpressionEngine](https://themeforest.net/category/cms-themes/expressionengine): ExpressionEngine themes for publishers and custom CMS implementations.

## Marketing & Email
- [Marketing Templates](https://themeforest.net/category/marketing): Design assets for email, landing pages, and promotional campaigns.
- [Email Templates](https://themeforest.net/category/marketing/email-templates): Responsive email templates for newsletters, promotions, and transactional campaigns.
- [Landing Pages](https://themeforest.net/category/marketing/landing-pages): Marketing landing page templates optimized for lead capture and product launches.
- [Unbounce Landing Pages](https://themeforest.net/category/marketing/landing-pages/unbounce): Unbounce templates for campaign pages and conversion-focused marketing funnels.

## Template Kits & Builders
- [Elementor Template Kits](https://themeforest.net/category/wordpress/template-kits): Template kits for quickly assembling WordPress sites with page builders.
- [Elementor Compatible Items](https://themeforest.net/attributes/compatible-with/elementor): Marketplace items marked as compatible with Elementor workflows.
- [WPBakery Page Builder Compatible Items](https://themeforest.net/attributes/compatible-with/wpbakery%20page%20builder): Themes and templates supporting WPBakery Page Builder integration.
- [WooCommerce Compatible Items](https://themeforest.net/attributes/compatible-with/woocommerce): Marketplace items tagged for WooCommerce compatibility and store building.
- [Bootstrap Compatible Items](https://themeforest.net/attributes/compatible-with/bootstrap): Templates built with or compatible with the Bootstrap framework.

## Authors & Selling
- [Start Selling](https://author.envato.com/): Author onboarding and selling information for Envato Market creators.
- [Author Directory](https://themeforest.net/authors): Browse marketplace authors and creator profiles on ThemeForest.
- [Top Authors](https://themeforest.net/authors/top): Discover leading authors by sales performance and marketplace reputation.
- [Author Profile Example](https://themeforest.net/user/ThemePunch): Example author profile showing items, portfolio, and marketplace activity.
- [Become an Author](https://author.envato.com/become-an-author): Overview of how to start selling digital products on Envato.
- [Author Help Center](https://help.author.envato.com/hc/en-us): Support documentation for authors selling on Envato Market.

## Account & User Activity
- [Sign In](https://themeforest.net/sign_in): User sign-in page for ThemeForest and Envato Market accounts.
- [Create Account](https://themeforest.net/sign_up): Registration page for new buyer and author accounts.
- [User Feed](https://themeforest.net/follow_feed): Personalized feed of followed authors, items, and marketplace activity.
- [Collections](https://themeforest.net/collections): Save and browse curated collections from users and the community.
- [Forums](https://forums.envato.com/): Community discussion forum for buyers, authors, and Envato users.

## Help & Ecosystem
- [ThemeForest Help Center](https://help.market.envato.com/hc/en-us): Buyer support, licensing, purchasing, and account help for Envato Market.
- [Licenses](https://help.market.envato.com/hc/en-us/articles/115005593363-ThemeForest-Licenses): Explanation of ThemeForest licensing options and usage rights.
- [Envato Elements](https://elements.envato.com/): Unlimited-download subscription service for creative assets and templates.
- [Tuts+](https://tutsplus.com/): Tutorials and courses covering design, code, business, and creative skills.
- [Placeit](https://placeit.net/): Online mockup, logo, design, and video creation platform from Envato.
- [Envato Community](https://community.envato.com/): Community hub for events, discussions, and creator engagement across Envato.
